newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat slips in brisk trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat slips in brisk trade.

text.p: Argentine wheat lost ground at midsession in brisk cash market trade at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, as producers were finally tempted out into the open to sell, traders said.

Wheat futures slipped too in technical switching of positions on the last trading day for January. The cash price paid to farmers for Bahia Blanca spot wheat shed $2 to $140. Maize prices were unchanged in slow trade, with cash April steady at $98. Soybeans rose after higher Chicago prices amid tight turnover. May soybeans gained $3 to $250. March sunflower seed was dragged up by soy, rising $3 to $215.
